request.state:
Target: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: Integrity and Transparency Reports, First Quarter 2023.

Decision cutoff: 2023-05-17T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: Integrity and Transparency Reports, First Quarter 2023. Published: 2023-05-17. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2023/05/integrity-and-transparency-reports-q1-2023.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: Today, we’re publishing our first quarter reports for 2023, including the Community Standards Enforcement Report, Oversight Board Quarterly Update , Transparency Report for the second half of 2022 ( Intellectual Property , Government Requests ) and Widely Viewed Content Report . All of these reports are available in our Transparency Center . The Oversight Board has been a valuable source of external perspective and accountability for Meta for over two years — and they continued to provide significant impact in the first quarter of 2023. We are also reviewing the board’s recommendations and will respond publicly within 60 days of their decision. While we did not see a material increase in case reviews and decisions during the first quarter of this year compared to previous quarters, we hope that the board will significantly increase its output next quarter and beyond.

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

Expectations: No point-in-time analyst consensus or market-implied expectation is available.

No company-wide comparable financial baselines or incremental magnitude inputs were supplied. Do not infer that a large headline amount is material to the target.

The stock showed a modest past rise over the latest completed session, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The stock showed a modest past rise over the recent trading week, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The stock showed a substantial past rise over the recent trading month, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The stock's recent daily variability was elevated. Variability describes the size of ordinary fluctuations, not their future direction.

The broad market (SPY) showed a substantial past rise over the latest completed session, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The broad market (SPY) showed a modest past rise over the recent trading week, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The broad market (SPY) showed a very small past rise over the recent trading month, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The broad market (SPY)'s recent daily variability was relatively subdued. Variability describes the size of ordinary fluctuations, not their future direction.

Over the recent trading week, the stock showed modest outperformance relative to the broad market.

Over the recent trading month, the stock showed substantial outperformance relative to the broad market.

These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was only slightly favored. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is much narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
